chunks: From him, from Hammad, from Shu'ayb, from Abi Basir, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about the pregnant woman who sees blood. He said: Yes, indeed a woman may sometimes discharge blood while she is pregnant.
ai.seo_question: Can a pregnant woman see blood according to the hadith of Imam Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the legal issue of a pregnant woman seeing blood. Imam Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام affirms that a pregnant woman may indeed discharge blood, indicating recognition of this occurrence in jurisprudential discussion.
